title: Check yourself: Commands and skills are one mechanism

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A project holds `.claude/commands/deploy.md`, and a teammate then adds `.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md`. What does `/deploy` run?

options.text: The command, because it was in the project first of the two
options.says: Ruled out because "A skill beats a command file of the same name", and the order of arrival plays no part.

options.text: Both, one after the other, with the command going first
options.says: Ruled out because the two formats are "one mechanism with the skill format as the richer one", so one name resolves to one definition.

options.text: The skill, since it takes precedence over the older format
options.says: The product merged the two formats and gives the skill precedence over a command file of the same name.

options.text: Neither, because the duplicate name is refused outright
options.says: Ruled out because "Existing command files keep working", and a shared name is settled by precedence and not refused.

origin.section: The name decides which one runs

questions.stem: A skill folder sits under `.claude/skills/` in a nested folder two levels below where the session began. When does it become available?

options.text: The first time Claude reads or edits a file in that location
options.says: Skills in a lower folder load when Claude first works with a file there.

options.text: At startup, together with the skills at the repository root
options.says: Ruled out because a lower skill loads "the first time Claude reads or edits a file in that subdirectory", and not at startup.

options.text: Never, since only skills at the repository root are read
options.says: Ruled out because project skills are found "from the directory where you start and from every parent up to the repository root", and a lower folder loads on first use.

options.text: Only after a restart that begins inside that folder
options.says: Ruled out because once loaded, the skills "stay available for the rest of the session", with no restart.

origin.section: Where the file lives decides who gets it
